meta.validation: NOT clinically validated. Educational teaching summaries; weights are heuristic ordering aids, NOT probabilities.
meta.source: General undergraduate teaching knowledge. Reviewer must attach exact textbook/guideline citations before any use beyond learning.
meta.population: Adults unless stated; paediatric and pregnancy-specific rules are not yet included.
meta.limits: Few diseases and symptoms only. Absent features never exclude a disease.

diseases.name: Community-acquired pneumonia
diseases.inv: Chest X-ray, CBC, oxygen saturation, CRP; cultures if severe.
diseases.tool: CURB-65/CRB-65 estimate severity after pneumonia is diagnosed; they are not diagnostic.
diseases.alt: Pulmonary TB, pulmonary embolism, heart failure, lung cancer

diseases.name: Acute bronchitis / viral chest infection
diseases.inv: Usually clinical; chest X-ray if pneumonia is suspected.
diseases.tool: Diagnosis of exclusion: pneumonia, TB and asthma must be considered first.
diseases.alt: Pneumonia, asthma, TB

diseases.name: Pulmonary tuberculosis
diseases.inv: Sputum smear/CBNAAT (Xpert), chest X-ray, HIV test, per national TB programme guidance.
diseases.tool: Follow NTEP presumptive-TB criteria; no scoring rule is used here.
diseases.alt: Lung cancer, bronchiectasis, pneumonia, fungal infection

diseases.name: Asthma / COPD (airway obstruction)
diseases.inv: Peak flow, SpO2, chest X-ray; spirometry when stable.
diseases.tool: GOLD/GINA define diagnosis and severity; apply separately.
diseases.alt: Heart failure, PE, pneumonia

diseases.name: Heart failure
diseases.inv: ECG, chest X-ray, NT-proBNP, echocardiography, renal function.
diseases.alt: Pneumonia, COPD, PE, renal or liver disease

diseases.name: Pulmonary embolism
diseases.inv: Clinical probability assessment, D-dimer where appropriate, CT pulmonary angiography or V/Q scan, ECG.
diseases.tool: Wells score and PERC are validated for suspected PE in specific outpatient/ED populations only; pregnancy needs a different pathway.
diseases.alt: Pneumonia, ACS, pneumothorax, heart failure

diseases.name: Acute coronary syndrome
diseases.inv: Immediate ECG, serial troponin, risk stratification per local protocol.
diseases.tool: HEART score is for undifferentiated chest pain in emergency settings; use only in its intended population.
diseases.alt: PE, aortic dissection, pericarditis, GERD, musculoskeletal pain

diseases.name: Aortic dissection
diseases.inv: Urgent senior decision on CT aortography; ECG; BP in both arms.
diseases.alt: ACS, PE, pneumothorax

diseases.name: Dengue fever
diseases.inv: CBC with platelets and haematocrit, NS1 antigen or IgM, liver enzymes; watch warning signs.
diseases.tool: Use national dengue case definitions and warning-sign checklist.
diseases.alt: Malaria, enteric fever, viral fever, leptospirosis

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.inv: Peripheral smear and/or rapid diagnostic test, CBC.
diseases.tool: None applied. Any fever in an endemic area needs testing.
diseases.alt: Dengue, enteric fever, sepsis

diseases.name: Enteric (typhoid) fever
diseases.inv: Blood culture (best early), CBC. Widal test has limited reliability.
diseases.alt: Malaria, dengue, TB, brucellosis

diseases.name: Meningitis / encephalitis
diseases.inv: Urgent senior review, blood cultures, lumbar puncture when safe (imaging first if criteria met).
diseases.alt: Sepsis, cerebral malaria, SAH, migraine

diseases.name: Subarachnoid haemorrhage
diseases.inv: Urgent non-contrast CT head; further tests per senior.
diseases.tool: Ottawa SAH rule applies only to alert adults with new severe non-traumatic headache.
diseases.alt: Migraine, meningitis, intracranial haemorrhage

diseases.name: Intracranial mass or bleed / raised ICP
diseases.inv: CT or MRI brain; fundoscopy for papilloedema.
diseases.alt: Migraine, meningitis, SAH

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.inv: Clinical diagnosis; imaging only if red flags.
diseases.tool: ICHD criteria define migraine; apply separately.
diseases.alt: Tension headache, SAH, meningitis

diseases.name: Acute appendicitis
diseases.inv: CBC, CRP, ultrasound or CT per age/local practice; pregnancy test in women.
diseases.tool: Alvarado/AIR scores exist; verify their populations before use.
diseases.alt: Ectopic pregnancy, gastroenteritis, ureteric colic, ovarian pathology

diseases.name: Ectopic pregnancy
diseases.inv: Urgent β-hCG and transvaginal ultrasound; check haemodynamics.
diseases.alt: Appendicitis, miscarriage, ovarian torsion

diseases.name: Acute gastroenteritis
diseases.inv: Usually clinical; assess dehydration; stool tests if bloody or persistent.
diseases.alt: Enteric fever, appendicitis, inflammatory bowel disease

diseases.name: Viral upper respiratory infection
diseases.inv: Usually none.
diseases.alt: Bronchitis, pneumonia, influenza, dengue

diseases.name: Scabies
diseases.inv: Clinical diagnosis; dermoscopy or skin scraping where available.
diseases.alt: Eczema, urticaria, fungal infection, insect bites

diseases.name: Urticaria (allergic or idiopathic)
diseases.inv: Clinical; look for triggers (drug, food, infection).
diseases.alt: Anaphylaxis, drug rash, urticarial vasculitis (if lesions last over 24 h)

diseases.name: Dermatophyte (fungal) skin infection
diseases.inv: KOH microscopy of scrapings.
diseases.alt: Eczema, psoriasis, pityriasis rosea

diseases.name: Eczema / dermatitis
diseases.inv: Clinical; consider contact triggers.
diseases.alt: Scabies, psoriasis, fungal infection, contact dermatitis

diseases.name: Cellulitis / bacterial skin infection
diseases.inv: Clinical; CBC and blood glucose; blood cultures if systemically unwell.
diseases.alt: Necrotising fasciitis (pain out of proportion), DVT, contact dermatitis, erysipelas

diseases.name: Severe cutaneous drug reaction (SJS/TEN)
diseases.inv: Urgent specialist review; stop suspected drug as directed by clinician; skin biopsy.
diseases.alt: Morbilliform drug rash, viral exanthem, erythema multiforme

diseases.name: Anaphylaxis / angioedema
diseases.inv: Clinical emergency; serum tryptase after the event.
diseases.alt: Urticaria, asthma, panic attack

diseases.name: Acute tonsillitis / pharyngitis
diseases.inv: Clinical; rapid antigen test or throat culture where available.
diseases.tool: Centor/McIsaac scores estimate likelihood of streptococcal pharyngitis in sore throat; use within the intended population only.
diseases.alt: Viral pharyngitis, infectious mononucleosis, diphtheria, peritonsillar abscess

diseases.name: Peritonsillar abscess
diseases.inv: Urgent ENT/senior review; imaging if needed.
diseases.alt: Tonsillitis, epiglottitis, deep neck infection

diseases.name: Acute otitis media
diseases.inv: Otoscopy.
diseases.alt: Otitis externa, referred pain (throat, teeth), mastoiditis

diseases.name: Otitis externa
diseases.inv: Otoscopy.
diseases.alt: Otitis media, furuncle, malignant otitis externa in diabetics

diseases.name: Acute rhinosinusitis
diseases.inv: Clinical; imaging only for complications or chronic disease.
diseases.alt: Allergic rhinitis, viral URTI, nasal polyps, orbital complications

diseases.name: Infective conjunctivitis
diseases.inv: Clinical.
diseases.alt: Keratitis, uveitis, acute angle-closure, foreign body

diseases.name: Acute angle-closure glaucoma
diseases.inv: Urgent ophthalmology review; intraocular pressure measurement.
diseases.alt: Uveitis, keratitis, migraine, conjunctivitis

diseases.name: Acute vision-threatening cause (e.g. retinal detachment, retinal vascular occlusion)
diseases.inv: Urgent ophthalmology review, fundus examination, vascular risk assessment.
diseases.alt: Stroke/TIA, optic neuritis, vitreous haemorrhage, migraine aura

diseases.name: Septic arthritis
diseases.inv: Urgent joint aspiration and culture, CBC, CRP, blood cultures; senior review.
diseases.alt: Gout, reactive arthritis, haemarthrosis, cellulitis

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis
diseases.inv: Clinical; X-ray if diagnosis uncertain.
diseases.alt: Rheumatoid arthritis, gout, referred pain

diseases.name: Rheumatoid / inflammatory arthritis
diseases.inv: RF, anti-CCP, ESR/CRP, X-rays.
diseases.tool: ACR/EULAR classification criteria apply to defined populations; use separately.
diseases.alt: Osteoarthritis, viral arthritis, SLE, psoriatic arthritis

diseases.name: Mechanical low back pain / lumbar radiculopathy
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI only if red flags or persistent radiculopathy.
diseases.alt: Cauda equina syndrome, fracture, infection, malignancy, renal colic

diseases.name: Cauda equina syndrome
diseases.inv: Emergency MRI spine; urgent neurosurgical/senior review.
diseases.alt: Mechanical back pain, spinal tumour, infection

diseases.name: Serious spinal cause (fracture, infection, metastasis)
diseases.inv: X-ray/MRI, ESR/CRP, per clinician.
diseases.alt: Mechanical back pain, myeloma, spinal TB

diseases.name: Depressive episode
diseases.inv: Clinical interview; PHQ-9 is a screening tool only; check thyroid function and rule out medical causes.
diseases.alt: Hypothyroidism, bipolar disorder, grief/adjustment disorder, substance-related

diseases.name: Substance-related or medical cause of low mood
diseases.inv: Clinical; substance history, thyroid, B12, other tests as indicated.
diseases.alt: Depressive episode, bipolar disorder
